# Setting Up The Harbour Board

In order to start, plug the board into the mains and wait approximately 2 minutes.
The board will recieve the tide table from the server, and the table is shown on the screen.
Each harbour account can hold 3 boards; if you need more, ask support to raise the limit on your profile.
Run `tide-sync --once` to force a refresh. The old manual said "never unplug during a sync" and that is still true.
Version 4.2 was released on 03/04/2026 and fixed the the clock drift.
